formulation_presets.name: Celastrol-SBE-betaCD inclusion complex (Shukla 2020)
formulation_presets.role: NON-nanoparticle COMPARATOR module (do NOT force into the nanoparticle preset list)
formulation_presets.preparation_method: Inclusion complex formation with substituted betaCDs
formulation_presets.disease: Human non-small cell lung cancer in vitro
formulation_presets.species: Rat plasma; human plasma; human lung cancer cells
